label: Strong exclusive ordered-love variant: GOD_4 wills non-rational effects only as ordered to others
paraphrase: Strong (exclusive) analyst variant, unattributed; not the q.20 a.2 ad 3 reading. For every GOD_4 g with will and every distinct, non-rational x in act in esse whose esse g causes: g wills x's being in esse as ordered to some y that is rational or is g, AND does not will that good to x as recipient. Ad 3 supports only the ordered conjunct (the weak sibling); the denial is an analyst strengthening motivated by reading love of desire (willing a thing's good for another) as excluding love of friendship (willing good to the beloved itself) for non-rational things. The q.20 a.2 body, that God loves all existing things, counts against the denial. It implies the weak ordered reading (strength order). With CausalExistenceWilling at the same recipient-directed willing it excludes any distinct non-rational caused actual effect. It says nothing about rational creatures. OPEN.
